confess_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_2.text: There's one last place I want to show you.

confess_seo_3.name: {name}
confess_seo_3.text: *The rooftop. Sunset paints the school. I can see the railing where Seoyeon looked down on the first day.*

confess_seo_3b.name: {name}
confess_seo_3b.text: *The rooftop. The sunset paints the school. A place that became familiar in just a few days.*

confess_seo_4.name: {name}
confess_seo_4.text: *Seoyeon is leaning against the railing. The wind catches her hair. — She tucks it back with her pinky. That habit.*

confess_seo_4_b.name: {name}
confess_seo_4_b.text: *My breath goes shallow. Same as my old school. — Words I swallowed back then.*

confess_seo_choice.name: {name}
confess_seo_choice.text: *The confession-practice memo folds and unfolds in her palm. The crease is now three layers deep.*

confess_seo_yes_1.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_1.text: *Seoyeon turns around. The wind whips through her hair.*

confess_seo_yes_2.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_2.text: *My breath catches in my throat. Still, this time I won't avoid it.*

confess_seo_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_3.text: *Sentences written and erased at my old school come to mind. This time I didn't pull out my phone from my pocket.*

confess_seo_yes_4.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_4.text: Seoyeon. Everyone sees you as the one who has it all together, right? But what sticks with me are the moments you let your guard down for a second.

confess_seo_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_5.text: *The words tangle. I never prepared any — and I can't stop.*

confess_seo_yes_6.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_6.text: Not the council president — moments when you were just Seoyeon. Those are the ones I keep coming back to.

confess_seo_yes_8.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_8.text: *Seoyeon says nothing. Her lips are trembling. Not the student council president — just a girl, standing there.*

confess_seo_yes_10.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_10.text: ...That 'I'm flattered' you said at the gate. I've been thinking about you ever since.

confess_seo_yes_11.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_yes_11.text: It took me forever to bring this up.

confess_seo_yes_12.name: {name}
confess_seo_yes_12.text: *Seoyeon holds out her pinky. The same pinky I saw on the first day. — Back then I thought it was just a habit, but this is Seoyeon's way of making a promise.*

confess_seo_no_2.name: {name}
confess_seo_no_2.text: *She said the same thing on the first day. Seoyeon's finger stops at the edge of the clipboard.*

confess_seo_no_3.name: {name}
confess_seo_no_3.text: *Seoyeon smiles. A practiced smile. — She turns and walks away. On the third step, she stops.*

confess_seo_no_4.name: Seoyeon
confess_seo_no_4.text: ...Next time you come here, have something else to say to me.

confess_yuna_1.name: {name}
confess_yuna_1.text: *The date is winding down. Yuna stops walking.*

confess_yuna_3.name: {name}
confess_yuna_3.text: *Library annex. The secret reading spot. Sunset seeps through the window. Yuna's bookmark rests beside the old sofa.*

confess_yuna_3b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_3b.text: *The library annex. Sunset seeps through the windows. A place that became familiar in just a few days.*

confess_yuna_4.name: {name}
confess_yuna_4.text: *Yuna is sitting on the sofa, looking at me. As if she'd been waiting.*

confess_yuna_choice.name: {name}
confess_yuna_choice.text: *My breath is getting shorter. The reason this silence felt comfortable — was because it was Yuna. I have to say it.*
choices: Yuna. Let me ask you one thing.

confess_yuna_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_3.text: Yuna. At first I thought your silence was a wall. It wasn't.

confess_yuna_yes_3_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_3_b.text: When I'm next to you, the silence never feels uncomfortable.

confess_yuna_yes_4.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_4.text: *In front of Yuna, I don't need a long speech. She's the kind of person who reads between the lines.*

confess_yuna_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_5.text: You're the kind of person who sits next to someone instead of speaking. That silence was warmer than anything anyone's said to me.

confess_yuna_yes_6_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_6_b.text: *The day my words ran longer than Yuna's. — A first.*

confess_yuna_yes_8.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_8.text: *Yuna's blank expression cracks. Her usual quiet voice disappears, replaced by the tiniest — almost inaudible — whisper. She grips her sleeve tight.*

confess_yuna_yes_8_c.name: Yuna
confess_yuna_yes_8_c.text: ...Don't go. I don't want you to just disappear.

confess_yuna_yes_9_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_yes_9_b.text: *'This time.' Yuna's breath catches just slightly on those two words. She doesn't let go of my hand.*

confess_yuna_no_2.name: {name}
confess_yuna_no_2.text: *Yuna nods. She slips the bookmark between the pages, then pushes it in deeper.*

confess_yuna_no_3.name: {name}
confess_yuna_no_3.text: *Yuna picks up a book. She's looking at the cover, but she's not reading.*

confess_yuna_no_4_b.name: {name}
confess_yuna_no_4_b.text: *Three steps away, I looked back. Yuna was watching me too, over the top of her book.*

confess_dain_1.name: {name}
confess_dain_1.text: *The date is winding down. Dain runs toward the school.*

confess_dain_3.name: {name}
confess_dain_3.text: *The gym. Empty. Sunset stains the court through the windows. The line from our first-day bet is still visible.*

confess_dain_3b.name: {name}
confess_dain_3b.text: *The gym. Empty. Sunset seeps through the windows onto the court. A place where so many memories were made in just a few days.*

confess_dain_4.name: {name}
confess_dain_4.text: *Dain is holding a ball. Casually. — But her fingers are white. She's gripping it tight.*

confess_dain_choice.name: {name}
confess_dain_choice.text: *Dain's ball bounces once. The hand that would've caught it normally stops in midair a beat too late.*

confess_dain_yes_3.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_3.text: Dain. There's — something I need to tell you.

confess_dain_yes_3_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_3_b.text: When your eyes aren't on me — it gets hard to breathe.

confess_dain_yes_4.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_4.text: *It's not a big dramatic confession or anything. But this is everything to me.*

confess_dain_yes_5.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_5.text: That's why I keep coming back to you.

confess_dain_yes_8.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_8.text: *Dain freezes. The laughter is gone from her face. Only her eyes slowly fill with tears. She covers her face with both hands.*

confess_dain_yes_8_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_8_b.text: *She covers her face with both hands. Through the gaps between her fingers, red cheeks are visible.*

confess_dain_yes_9.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_9.text: ...Wait, I'm gonna cry... I'm happy, so why am I crying...

confess_dain_yes_9_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_9_b.text: *She lowers her hands and smiles. Tears are running down her face.*

confess_dain_yes_10.name: Dain
confess_dain_yes_10.text: I like you too. So much.

confess_dain_yes_10_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_yes_10_b.text: *'So much.' — Dain is always like this. Short and honest. That's why I believe her.*

confess_dain_no_2.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_2.text: *I can set a ball for her, but I can't say three words. Pathetic.*

confess_dain_no_3.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_3.text: *Dain bounces a volleyball. Once. Twice. — On the third bounce, she stops.*

confess_dain_no_4_b.name: {name}
confess_dain_no_4_b.text: *No exclamation mark. Dain adjusts her wrist guard.*
